prompt: A country road at night, a fake police roadblock. A skinny Irish American man of 22 crouches beside one burst wooden beer barrel, facing us square on: hollow cheeks, pale smooth skin, big jug ears sticking out under a peaked cap too large for him, crooked front teeth, mouth wide. His oversized dark police tunic hangs open at a thin neck, its collar far below his chin. The lens lies at road height, in the foam. Beer spreads toward us in a shining sheet that runs off every side of the picture. A red road lantern at his knee lights his face from beneath, mouth and chin clear. Far behind him, a stopped 1920s flat-bed truck, its load tarped, sits small in cold blue moonlight. Thanks.
